page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left page blank (verso); right page is a title page, cut off at the right edge of the scan, so only the left part of its lines is visible. No other blocks.
page.notes: The left printed page is blank. The right page is a title page, but the scan cuts it off at the right edge, so only the first letters of each line are visible; the rest of each line is not on the scan and is marked illegible. The visible fragments are: "JOH" at the top in small capitals; "VE" in spaced capitals; "REF" in large capitals; "INT" in large capitals; a small line beginning "Lu"; a small italic-looking line beginning "Addita"; a line beginning "Le"; and a bottom line beginning "Apud". The fragments "Addita" and "Apud" are uncertain. The page has no page number, running head, catchword or signature. The scan credit line at the foot (Early European Books, ProQuest, Koninklijke Bibliotheek, shelf mark 233 G 7) is not printed text and is left out.
